title: 關於我們頁面全面 redesign (內容 + 版面 + 多語)
content: About Us 頁面目前僅完成 i18n 遷移（CT-003），內容與版面仍為初版。本卡片進行全面 redesign：重寫視覺佈局（品牌故事、里程碑時間軸、團隊介紹、服務數據）、更豐富的內容（附真實照片/圖示佔位）、並確保三語內容各自在地化（非單純翻譯）。

findings: About page exists at src/app/[locale]/about/page.tsx with i18n dictionary (CT-003 done)
Current content is basic — needs richer storytelling and visual layout
Design system tokens and component library available (PS-007 through PS-011)
evidence.residual: Requires UI mockup gate before implementation. Photos/illustrations will use placeholder images — final assets provided by client.

acceptance: Redesigned about page with sections: hero/banner, brand story, mission & values, milestone timeline, team introduction, service statistics (courses delivered, learners served, years established)
Consistent with institutional slate/emerald design system and existing page templates (breadcrumbs, typography, spacing)
Each locale has culturally appropriate content — not word-for-word translation
Icon usage from lucide-react, images use next/image with placeholders
Dictionary extended with all new section keys in types.ts and all 3 locale files
All interactive states (hover, focus, active) follow design system patterns
files: src/dictionaries/types.ts (update — add about page dict type)
verification: Visit /en/about → full redesigned page with all sections. Switch to /zh-hk/about → Traditional Chinese localized content. Switch to /zh-cn/about → Simplified Chinese localized content. Mobile layout stacks properly. npm run typecheck + npm run lint pass.
